source.document: Honda Aiming Driving Support Systems Job Aid (March 2021, Version 6)
source.applies_to_note: All models with millimeter wave radar, FCW/LDW camera, multipurpose camera, multi-view camera, or BSI radar. Honda does not equip vehicles with front corner radars.

general_requirements: Proper wheel alignment, body structural alignment, and camera/radar alignment are critical to driving support system functions. If aiming a radar or camera is necessary due to a collision, a four-wheel alignment check must be performed first and corrected prior to aiming any camera or radar.

components.location: Behind front Honda emblem, lower center of front bumper grille, or to the side behind front bumper trim (varies by model)

model_exclusions.reason: Per Honda job aid: 2022+ Civic is not equipped with a millimeter wave radar. Driving support functions are integrated into the multipurpose camera unit.
Per Honda job aid: 2023+ HR-V (3rd gen) is not equipped with a millimeter wave radar. Driving support functions are integrated into the multipurpose camera unit.

triggers: Millimeter wave radar unit is removed and installed
Millimeter wave radar unit is replaced
After a collision repair that would require at least a front bumper fascia repair within 300 mm of the radar unit

After a collision repair requiring a structural body repair (any damage beyond minor cosmetic abrasions to the welded, riveted, or bonded parts of the main unibody, bumper reinforcements, door intrusion beams, or bolt-on front bulkheads)
After a Supplemental Restraint System (SRS) deployment
DTC P2583-54 (millimeter wave radar aiming incomplete) is set
DTC P2583-64 (millimeter wave radar aiming error) is set
DTC P2583-97 (dust or dirt on the millimeter wave radar) is set

components.calibration_note: Replacement windshield must be Honda genuine — aftermarket windshields will cause aiming failure or abnormal system operation.
triggers: Windshield is removed and installed
Windshield is replaced
Multipurpose camera unit or FCW/LDW camera unit is removed and installed
Multipurpose camera unit or FCW/LDW camera unit is replaced
After a collision repair requiring a structural body repair
After a Supplemental Restraint System (SRS) deployment
DTC B2A60-52 (dynamic camera aiming incomplete) is set
DTC B2A60-54 (static camera aiming incomplete / FCW-LDW camera aiming incomplete) is set

components.location: Four cameras: front grille, rear (rearview camera), and left/right outside mirrors
components.calibration_note: Do only the camera aiming applicable to the component that was removed, adjusted, or damaged. Mirror housing lower cover is a trigger on some models — refer to model service info.
triggers: Front camera is replaced, removed, or reinstalled
Rearview camera is replaced, removed, or reinstalled
Left or right side camera is replaced, removed, or reinstalled
Power mirror assembly is replaced, removed, or reinstalled
Mirror housing lower cover is replaced, removed, or reinstalled (some models)
Front bumper is replaced, removed, or reinstalled
Front grille is replaced, removed, or reinstalled
Driver's or front passenger's door is replaced, removed, or reinstalled
Tailgate is replaced, removed, or reinstalled
Trunk is replaced, removed, or reinstalled
Driver's or front passenger's door has been adjusted
Tailgate has been adjusted
Trunk has been adjusted
After any collision repairs to the driver's or front passenger's door
DTC B14B3-54 (camera aiming incomplete) is set

components.location: Left and right sides of the rear body panel, behind the rear bumper (mounting position varies by model)
components.calibration_note: If the BSI radar unit was replaced due to damage, the BSI Radar Unit Mounting Area Check is required before installing the new unit. 2022+ Civic uses the Blind Spot Information (BSI) System Learning Value Reset procedure.
triggers: BSI radar unit is removed and installed
BSI radar unit is replaced
After replacing or repairing the body panel(s) where the BSI radar unit is mounted
After a collision repair requiring a structural body repair at the rear of the vehicle
DTC B18B8 (left side BSI radar unit azimuth off alignment) is set
DTC B1E68 (right side BSI radar unit azimuth off alignment) is set
LaneWatch camera unit is replaced or removed and installed
Passenger side power mirror assembly is replaced or removed and installed
Front passenger door is replaced or removed and installed
After adjusting the front passenger door
After any collision repairs to the door assembly

components.location: Built into the front passenger seat cushion frame
components.calibration_note: Weight sensor is built into the seat cushion frame. An output check is required after any vehicle collision, regardless of airbag or seat belt tensioner deployment. Weight sensor initialization is required any time the seat cushion frame or the SRS unit is serviced.
triggers: Vehicle is in for repair after any collision (regardless of whether airbags or seat belt tensioners deployed)
The front passenger's seat cushion frame is replaced or removed
The SRS unit is replaced or updated
